title: Threshold width
statement: Let $\epsilon$ satisfy $0<\epsilon<\tfrac12$, and let $f$ be a monotone, nonconstant Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional cube. Its threshold width is its upper threshold parameter minus its lower threshold parameter.
caveat: The upper and lower parameters use a biased probability level whose defining polynomial is not supplied.
